SKILLS DEVELOPMENT FUND ACT 2004

SKILLS DEVELOPMENT FUND (FEES) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 92(2)(c) and (e) of the

Skills Development Fund Act 2004 [Act 640], the Corporation, with the approval of the

Minister, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Skills Development Fund (Fees)

(Amendment) Regulations 2025.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 February 2025.

Substitution of Schedule

2. The Skills Development Fund (Fees) Regulations 2007 [P.U. (A) 243/2007]

are amended by substituting for the Schedule the following schedule:

".
